thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: high-severity page fired for service=az12-serving (nic-degrade). Escalation policy: az-oncall -> sre-lead.

Mike O: got the page, looking. anyone see customer reports?

Lina R: yep several 5xx spikes in the metrics dashboard for az12, latency up ~4x. Customer-facing errors on hosted API (generation).

Sam T: check control-plane metrics — control plane OK, but NIC errors on hosts in az12. I can see repeated link flaps on eni-az12-* in fabric logs.

Mike O: @Lina can you confirm if autopager kicked fallback? dashboard shows some divert attempts but not full activation.

Lina R: autopager attempted divert to az3 but stuck in PREP state for a few mins. Getting 'route-store: shadow mismatch' errors. Logs: ```2026-03-10T12:03:15Z route-store ERROR applyRoute: shadow mismatch: expected=5 got=3```

SRE Lead: @Sam start pre-failover checklist: (1) verify capacity in az3, (2) warm kvcache in az3 for top prefixes, (3) prepare canary routing. I'll take handoff if this escalates.

Sam T: running capacity check: az3 has ~120% spare capacity for current load when accounting for model shards. Running `redwoodctl capacity check --region az3 --buffer 20` now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by Mike O.

Mike O: acked. Sam, paste output when capacity check finishes. Lina, can you try a manual prefix cache sync to unblock the route-store shadow mismatch?

Lina R: doing `route-sync --target az3 --prefixes top100 --force` now. Will monitor.

Sam T: capacity check result: PASS. az3 all green, can absorb diverted traffic at 80% of current qps, latency expected +10-20ms under burst.

Lina R: route-sync completed. route-store no longer returns shadow mismatch. Re-issuing autopager divert: `autopager divert --from az12 --to az3 --policy emergency`

incident-bot: autopager: divert request submitted (id=divert-20260310-001). Current state: PENDING_CANARY.

Mike O: starting canary at 1% traffic now. watch for increase in 5xx and kvcache miss rates.

Lina R: canary looks okay after 30s. 5xx rate for diverted requests = 0.2% (baseline 0.1%), kv-cache misses temporarily +15% (warming). no CPU spikes.

SRE Lead: good. ramp to 25% over next 2 mins, if stable we'd flip remainder. @pagerduty-bot leave a note about customer impact: initial impact window and mitigations.

pagerduty-bot: Note added to incident: "NIC flaps in az12 caused elevated 5xx and latency for hosted API customers. Autopager divert to az3 initiated, canary healthy -> ramping. On-call: Mike O. Escalation: SRE Lead if fails."

Mike O: ramping to 25% now. Lina keep eye on model-shed retries. Sam, start a rolling reboot of the most-flapping NIC hosts in az12 as low-risk mitigation: `infractl host reboot --filter 'az:az12 and nic_errors>5' --serial 5`

Sam T: starting serial reboot. estimated completion ~8m. I'll abort if autopager continues to stabilize.

Lina R: at 25% ramp: 5xx rate back to 0.12%, tail latency improving. kvcache warms. Looks like divert is working.

Mike O: good news — customers reporting lower error rates in prod telemetry (internal customer-reports channel). Posting status update to #general in 5 minutes unless anything degrades.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation suppressed (on-call acknowledged).

SRE Lead: once Sam completes reboots, let's plan to run a preventive NIC firmware check for the hostpool in az12 and open a maintenance ticket with the infra provider. Also create an RCA tracking issue.

Sam T: reboots finished, flapping hosts rebooted, NIC errors dropped to near-zero on those machines.

Mike O: last check: diverted traffic at 60% and stable. decision: keep diversion until provider MTR complete and NIC firmware validated. Notifying Eng-SRE and Support for customer comms.

Lina R: adding mitigation notes: `mitigation/2026-03-10/az12-nic-divert`: autopager divert -> canary -> ramp, serial host reboots, kvcache warming.

SRE Lead: thanks team. Handing off monitoring to next-shift oncall. I'll create the incident doc and schedule postmortem draft.

Mike O: handing off to oncall-night. I'll post a concise incident summary to the pager duty incident and close the immediate page once next-shift ack. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Note: thread closed for active paging but incident remains open for RCA and provider coordination.
